Designing a text-to-image-to-video workflow

Connect creative stages while keeping review in the loop.

RunBridge AI · Field notes 2 min read

Define the creative brief

Begin with audience, message, visual direction and output constraints. Use text generation to create structured scene descriptions that can be reviewed before image production.

Review the image stage

Generate candidates and check the important details. Keep the approved image together with its prompt, version and settings so the next stage has clear context.

Manage video as a job

Video generation can take longer than an interactive text request. Design progress states around actual job status, and make refreshes recover the existing job rather than create a duplicate.

Measure the final output

Evaluate the completed asset against the original brief. Track review time and iteration count as well as model cost; a cheap generation is not always a cheap finished asset.
